audience: Patrick Deutsch as blog owner and readers who want useful, demonstrated engineering work.
problem: Related engineering changes lack a persistent path from real behavior to an accurate owner-approved blog release.
before: Obsidian posts sync to Zola automatically. No feature contract, evidence binding, independent Jev review, private editorial queue, or signed showcase release exists.
after: An internal tool groups changes by task, retains immutable evidence and reviews, and stages selected stories for an exact owner-signed release. Only public approved content reaches Zola.

requirements.action: Register requirements before work and attach landed changes with the same task identity
requirements.expected: Each requirement retains its original behavior, user action and result; legacy requirements require a verified owner signature.

requirements.action: Bind each requirement to commits, original media, an outcome, article section and inline figure
requirements.expected: Missing, changed or contradictory evidence blocks selection; production, controlled demonstrations and research remain distinct.

requirements.action: Review bounded complete source, then evidence and writing separately, then prominence
requirements.expected: Original typed answers, distributions, confidence, model and hashes persist; feedback enters only prominence; failed transport and completed judgments remain in history.

requirements.action: Open the local queue and sign promote, lower, skip, reject, defer or a correction
requirements.expected: Choices remain immutable; unselected work stays pending; changed feedback invalidates only ranking; decisions cannot waive evidence.

requirements.action: Prepare an exact blog commit, catalog and version, then have a person approve and sign a stable release
requirements.expected: Unsigned candidates and prereleases cannot publish; historical stories remain; meaningful work remains open until its deployed blog release is verified.

requirements.action: Build the public site or inspect public output
requirements.expected: No credentials, private review records, feedback, raw source review inputs or private repository identifiers enter the public output.

freeze_rule: This initial contract must be preserved after landing. Corrections add history and cannot remove original obligations.
status: proposed; no landing or completion claimed
